mapper.select: select room.* from cr_team_room room join cr_team_template template on template.resource_id = room.team_template_id where room.training_status = 2 and room.xd_type between 1 and 15 and not exists (select 1 from cr_demo_data_room demo where demo.room_id = room.resource_id) and exists (select 1 from cr_train_record record where record.room_id = room.resource_id and record.end_time > record.start_time) and exists (select 1 from cr_task task where task.room_id = room.resource_id) and exists (select 1 from cr_score score where score.room_id = room.resource_id)
mapper.insert: insert into cr_demo_data_run (business_date, generated_count, create_time) values (#{businessDate}, 0, current_timestamp)
mapper.update: update cr_demo_data_run set generated_count = #{count} where business_date = #{businessDate}
mapper.insert: insert into cr_demo_data_room (room_id, source_room_id, business_date, topo_digest) values (#{roomId}, #{sourceRoomId}, #{businessDate}, #{topoDigest})
